proof:
by
  have hidx' : idx' < tl.length := by
    simpa [List.length_cons] using hidx
  have key : ∀ (p q : List α) (n : ℕ) (e : α),
      p ++ q.insertIdx n e = (p ++ q).insertIdx (p.length + n) e := by
    intro p q n e
    induction p with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a p ih =>
      have hlen : (a :: p).length = p.length + 1 := rfl
      have hn : (a :: p).length + n = (p.length + n) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hn]
      simp [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, ih]
  rw [@HR tl l1 hidx', Nat.add_assoc]
  exact key hd ((tl.set idx' l1).flatten) ((List.take idx' (List.map List.length tl)).sum + l1.length) elt
